---
title: "About the Library"
---

This project treats each mechanics problem as a modular **scenario package** rather
than as a single calculation. A package may contain:

- a real-world image and scenario;
- open-ended engineering questions;
- a student packet;
- instructor notes and solution guidance;
- computational notebooks;
- rubrics and assessment variants;
- metadata for search, filtering, and reuse.

The physical folder structure is organized by problem package. Discovery is handled
through metadata rather than by forcing each problem into only one chapter.
